services.name: Bonafide Certificate
steps: Complete the certificate request form at the Academic Section counter.
Submit your student ID card details and fee receipt copy.
Collect the certificate after 2 working days.

services.name: Replacement Student ID Card
steps: Report the missing card at the Student Services Desk.
Complete the replacement card form.
Collect the new card when the desk confirms it is ready.

services.name: Hostel Maintenance Request
services.location: West Residence, Ground Floor, Room R-006
steps: Record the residence block and room number.
Submit a maintenance request to the Residential Life Office.
For an urgent safety concern, speak to the residence desk in person.

services.name: Campus Bus Pass
steps: Complete the campus transport request form.
Provide your student ID and route preference.
Collect the pass after the Transport Desk confirms processing.

services.name: Fee Payment Receipt Copy
steps: Submit a receipt-copy request to the Accounts Office.
Provide your student number and the academic term.
The office will advise when the copy is ready.
services.note: This entry explains how to request a receipt copy. It does not contain tuition amounts or account balances.

services.name: Academic Transcript Request
steps: Complete the academic record request form.
Submit your student ID details and required term range.
The Records Office will confirm the collection date.

services.name: Scholarship Verification Letter
steps: Request a scholarship verification letter at the Student Support Office.
Provide your student ID and scholarship award period.
The office will confirm the processing and collection details.

services.name: Examination Hall Ticket
steps: Check the student portal or ask the Examinations Office about the published issue date.
Bring your student ID if a printed copy is required.
Report an incorrect detail to the Examinations Office.
